title: Why Trump's claim that Iranians should take to the streets had to be rowed back | DW News
text:
With this war in its fifth day, and with US and Israeli fighter jets dominating the skies, and with almost no Iranian air defense capabilities, the Trump administration has kept up its barrage of often-contradictory reasons for starting this conflict in conjunction with Israel. Here’s a flavor of what the administration has said since the president announced the first attacks on Saturday morning.
